subject: MediCore security questionnaire planning and artifact timetable
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medicoresys.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@medicoresys.com
Date: Thu, 07 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial: MediCore security questionnaire + next steps

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for taking the time. Attached is our initial SIG spreadsheet (filled out with a few high-level answers) and a short list of follow-up questions the compliance team has around logging, key management, and data residency.

Can we schedule a 45-minute call next week to walk the questionnaire and agree on an artifact/timeline for evidence (logs, encryption diagrams, SOC 2 attestations)? Our preferred windows are: Tue 2/10 10–12 PT or Wed 2/11 14–16 PT.

Specific asks from MediCore security:
- Example log sample (7 days) or instructions to pull a sample
- Encryption at-rest architecture diagram and KMS vendor details
- Data retention policy excerpt and sample retention config

I've attached the filled SIG (partial) for context: MediCore_SIG-v1.pdf.

Elena Garcia
Security Program Manager
MediCore Systems
elena.garcia@medicoresys.com
+1 (415) 555-0138

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medicoresys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial: MediCore security questionnaire + next steps

Elena, thanks for the doc and the clear list. Good windows — we can do Tue 2/10 10:30–11:15 PT. Tentatively booked that slot; I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Quick answers up front:
- Log sample: we can provide a redacted 7-day sample from our hosted runtime. I'll coordinate with Rishi for the pull and sanitization.
- KMS: we use customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) for Dedicated and Redwood-managed envelope keys for hosted customers — I'll include the encryption diagram and the KMS owner.
- Retention: we have per-customer retention controls; I'll attach an export of the retention policy and an example config.

Attaching our CAIQ->SIG mapping (redwood-caiq-mapping-v2.xlsx) to speed the call.

Agenda proposal (30–45m):
1) Quick intros & scope (5m)
2) SIG/CAIQ mapping review (10m)
3) Evidence handoff approach (logs, diagrams, attestations) (15m)
4) Next steps & owners (5–10m)

If Marissa wants to join for evidence logistics, that's great — she knows our artifact pipeline.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Product Security (Solutions)
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medicoresys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: MediCore questionnaire call notes and owners

Thanks everyone for the call earlier — minutes and action items below. Attendees: Elena (MediCore), Jared Lee (MediCore legal), Michael (Redwood), Rishi (Infra), Marissa (CS).

Meeting highlights:
- Rishi demoed the log export process and confirmed IPs and PII fields will be redacted in the sample. We will produce a 7-day sample by 2026-02-12.
- Michael walked through CAIQ mapping; identified 12 SIG items that require artifacts rather than one-line answers.
- Marissa confirmed Redwood's artifact portal process and timeline expectations for attachments.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Rishi Malhotra: generate redacted log sample (7 days) and upload to drive by 2026-02-12 (redwood-asset-manifest-20260210.csv will list what is included).
- Michael Grant: supply encryption at-rest architecture diagram and KMS details, plus key rotation records example — due 2026-02-12.
- Marissa Cole: create artifact drop in shared drive and provide upload instructions and retention notes — due 2026-02-13.
- MediCore (Elena/Jared): confirm any remaining SIG fields that need legal wording by 2026-02-15.

Attachments referenced in call:
- redwood-caiq-mapping-v2.xlsx (attached)
- MediCore_SIG-v1.pdf (external)
- redwood-asset-manifest-20260210.csv (will be uploaded with log sample)

If I missed anything, reply-all and I'll update.

Best,
Michael Grant

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@medicoresys.com>, Jared Lee <jared.lee@medicoresys.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & internal notes: MediCore evidence handoff readiness

Internal summary for the operations team (copy to customer for transparency):

Quick status: Rishi uploaded the sanitized log sample to the Drive folder (link in related_links). I verified the manifest and the sample format against our artifact checklist.

Operational notes:
- Log sample contains: timestamp, request_id, masked_client_ip, api_key_id (hashed), route, status_code, user_agent (truncated). No raw PII included.
- Key rotation records: provided as example CSV (rotation-events-2025.csv) — redwood uses periodic rotation for envelope keys; dedicated customers may bring their own CMKs.
- Retention snippets: included in the artifact portal README — retention is configurable per-customer and we attached the config example.

Next operational steps:
1) Marissa to upload the full artifact set to the shared drive and mark items as "deliverable" in HUBSPOT-23456789 by 2026-02-13.
2) I will produce a short README (templates + redaction notes) for MediCore by 2026-02-13.
3) Michael to review any SIG legal wording flagged by MediCore and approve suggested language by 2026-02-15.

Notes for CS/ops: be prepared for a follow-up deep-dive on one of the SIG control families (Logging & Monitoring) if MediCore requests more granularity.

Thanks — Kimberly
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
